description: This Go source file defines functions for recursively sorting YAML node keys to match a specified order, primarily used for maintaining consistent field order in Kubernetes resource configurations. It includes functions for traversing YAML nodes, visiting fields and elements, and handling comments during reordering.

methods.name: SyncOrder
methods.description: Recursively sorts the map node keys in 'to' to match the order of 'from', preserving original order and avoiding unnecessary diffs.

methods.name: syncOrder
methods.description: Helper function that performs recursive sorting of YAML nodes based on their type.

methods.name: VisitElements
methods.description: Iterates over elements in a YAML sequence node, applying a provided function.

methods.name: VisitFields
methods.description: Iterates over fields in a YAML mapping node, applying a provided function.

methods.name: rearrangeHeadCommentOfSeqNode
methods.description: Addresses a corner case by transferring head comments from child nodes to parent sequence nodes to preserve comments after reordering.
